evals.prompt: I want a 10-second cinematic trailer of a lone astronaut walking across a red desert at dusk, with epic orchestral background music. Use Kie AI. I don't have credits to burn so keep it reasonable. KIE_API_KEY is not set in this environment, so don't actually call the API - give me the full plan, model choices with reasoning, and the exact payloads/commands I'd run.
evals.expected_output: Sequential plan image->video->audio->ffmpeg merge, models chosen with rationale, createTask payloads with Bearer auth, async taskId+polling, fetches docs.kie.ai first.
assertions: Plans stages in order image -> video -> audio -> merge
Fetches or cites docs.kie.ai for current models before choosing
Gives a rationale and runner-up for each chosen model
Uses POST /api/v1/jobs/createTask (or documented Direct API) with Bearer auth and no hardcoded key
Explains async: taskId returned first, then polling or callback
Feeds the image output URL into the video stage
Merges audio and video locally (ffmpeg) rather than claiming Kie does it
Notes cheaper draft tier or asks before costly runs

evals.prompt: Make me a poster-style image of a coffee shop storefront with the sign reading 'Bean There' in clean lettering, 3:4 aspect ratio, via Kie AI. Dry run only (no API key here): show which model you'd pick and why, the payload, and how you'd get the result back.
evals.expected_output: Picks a text-capable model (Ideogram/GPT Image/Seedream) with rationale, verified against docs, correct payload, async handling, mentions fallback.
assertions: Selects a text-rendering-capable model (Ideogram, GPT Image or Seedream) with rationale
Payload includes the exact sign text 'Bean There' and 3:4 aspect ratio in the model's own field names
Consults the model page rather than guessing parameters
Explains taskId + polling/callback retrieval and downloading results
Does not fabricate a generated result or taskId

evals.prompt: Using Kie AI, I need a 30-second narrated voiceover for a product demo (script: 'Meet Flowly, the calendar that plans itself.') and then an image-to-video clip from my logo at https://example.com/logo.png. Say the Veo model page shows it as degraded right now - what do you do? Dry run, no API key.
evals.expected_output: Chooses ElevenLabs/Gemini TTS, image-to-video with URL input, automatically falls back from Veo to next-best (Kling/Seedance) and says so, handles async, no fabricated results.
assertions: Uses a TTS model (ElevenLabs or Gemini) for narration
Passes https://example.com/logo.png as the image-to-video input URL
Automatically falls back from degraded Veo to another video model (Kling/Seedance/Wan) and states it
Handles async taskId/polling for both tasks
Does not fabricate results or a taskId given no API key
